feeds.description: Elegant Wedding is your one-stop blog, magazine, show, and wedding directory dedicated to helping brides find the best inspiration for their big day! Elegant Wedding is about unparalleled elegance, true style and sophistication inspiring creativity.

feeds.title: Vineyard Bride Blog
feeds.description: An endless selection of real weddings, engagements, editorials, industry professionals and celebrations to influence and inspire. Vineyard Bride's mission is to connect couples with quality local vendors, create a positive and encouraging network for industry professionals, and showcase Southern Ontario's loveliest and inspiring weddings, engagements, professionals + more.

feeds.title: Ottawa Wedding Magazine
feeds.description: Ottawa Wedding Magazine is the must-have guide for the city's brides to be, it provides all the information and options you need to make your dream of a wedding day come true. From news about the latest drop-dead gorgeous, fairytale dresses to advice about planning, shopping, and making innumerable arrangements, Ottawa Wedding provides the know-how you need to create a beautiful, picture-perfect occasion that people will talk about for years to come.

A visual exploration of beautiful and inspiring wedding editorials from the coast, to the stunning Canadian coast, and beyond.

feeds.description: Junebug Weddings is the essential guide to planning a stylish wedding. Find the best photographers, planners, venues, and wedding professionals worldwide.

Melissa Dawn Event Designs is an event planning and styling company serving Calgary and surrounding area.
